units: impacts per cm^2 per landing, anchored to Surveyor III

branch_filter.rule: keep a variant if, after calibrating K_D to the coupons' mean pit size (79 um, counting pits >= 20 um), its absolute N(pits >= 20 um) at Surveyor III lies between 1/3 x 103/cm^2 (coupon average) and 4000/cm^2 (tube maximum); variants with fewer than 20 simulated grains at Surveyor III, or whose calibration rests on fewer, are left out

descent_profile.note: median over erosion laws; rings in the replay scale with this fraction
